rework_notes: Review rejected the previous attempt. it does not conform to the Contract: Canvas._register_and_load installs its disconnect handler only after awaiting realtime.register_view, leaving a disconnect during subscription readiness unhandled; registration can subsequently finish with no connected view and no unregister call.
